description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and provides filtering functionality for attendance record searches in the OrangeHRM system. It includes filter parameters such as employee numbers, from date, and to date, along with default sorting setup.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object that encapsulates filter parameters specifically for searching attendance records, including sorting and date range filters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers to filter by.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the filter range.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the filter range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the filter range.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the filter range.
